summary: Targeted re-test of iteration_16 fixes + new Admin Events panel. Both iteration_16 issues are RESOLVED and the new /admin/events feature works end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (9 tests) — 100% pass. UI flows verified at mobile viewport 390x844 on Expo web preview. FIX 1 (orphan repeat-offenders no longer 404): every user_id returned by /api/admin/repeat-offenders now resolves to /api/admin/users/{id}/moderation with 200 + populated data (user object, counts.reports_total>0, reports[], moderation_log[]). UI: clicking Review on a repeat-offender row opens a fully-rendered card — e.g. 'Dorothy @dot · 3 Reports / 3 Open / 0 Actions' with 3 URGENT/NEW report entries listed. FIX 2 (Restore button always visible): admin-restore testID is rendered on every /admin/user/[id] page; correctly greyed (opacity 0.4) when user is ACTIVE and enabled when restricted/banned/profile_hidden. NEW FEATURE /admin/events: admin-manage-events quick link routes correctly; 4 tabs (Active·8 / Cancelled·0 / Archived·0 / All·8) with live counts; cards render with ACTIVE/CANCELLED/ARCHIVED badge, emoji, title (line-through when cancelled), date+time, location, host, going/waitlist/maybe counts; per-card testIDs event-edit-{id} / event-cancel-{id} / event-archive-{id} / event-delete-{id} all present and functional; restore/unarchive buttons correctly conditional. Full lifecycle (create → list → patch → cancel → cancelled-tab → archive → archived-tab → unarchive → cancelled-tab → hard-delete → vanished-from-all-tabs) verified via backend pytest. Public /events confirmed to hide archived events (test_05 PASS). Edit screen uses testIDs `edit-title`, `edit-save`, `edit-cancel`, `admin-hard-delete` (note: not event-title/event-submit per spec — but they work).

action_items: OPTIONAL (low-priority polish): /events/edit/[id].tsx uses testIDs `edit-title`, `edit-save`, `edit-cancel`. The spec / earlier screens use `event-title`, `event-submit`. Consider aligning them for selector consistency (or document the divergence in the test plan).
OPTIONAL (low-priority polish): still some RN-Web deprecation warnings from iter_16 (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents). Cleanup recommended but not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3942-3965 — repeat-offender enrichment now skips orphans cleanly with `if not u: continue`. Good defensive pattern.
admin/user/[id].tsx:229-236 — Restore button is rendered unconditionally inside an IIFE; disabled state is driven by `u.restricted || u.banned || u.profile_hidden`. Clean.

admin/events.tsx — uses window.prompt / window.confirm on web, falls through to Alert on native. Works for QA but on native the prompt() returns def directly without a real text input — actual reason capture only works on web. Consider a proper React modal if/when this ships to mobile.
admin/events.tsx — Restore and Unarchive testIDs are conditional (only when cancelled/archived) — consistent with admin/user/[id]. Good.
events/edit/[id].tsx:34-36 — uses api.listEvents().find(...) instead of GET /api/events/{id}. Slower (200-doc fetch) but works. Long-term: add GET /api/events/{id}.

rca_of_issue: Both iter_16 issues resolved correctly. Root cause of FIX 1 was server-side: /api/admin/repeat-offenders aggregation was returning user_ids from orphaned seed reports against deleted target users; now filters them out post-aggregation by checking db.users membership. Root cause of FIX 2 was UI: the Restore Pressable was simply not rendered in the JSX; added as an unconditional Pressable with a `needsRestore` enable flag.
